question: Identify the artist with the highest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order) and the artist with the lowest overall sales of albums (tie broken by alphabetical order), then calculate the amount each customer spent specifically on those two artists’ albums. Next, compute the average spending for the customers who purchased from the top-selling artist and the average spending for the customers who purchased from the lowest-selling artist, and finally return the absolute difference between these two averages.
sql:
WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) as total_sales
    FROM albums alb
    JOIN artists a ON alb.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON alb.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
),
ranked_artists AS (
    SELECT ArtistId, Name, total_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC, Name ASC) as rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales ASC, Name ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM artist_sales
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM ranked_artists WHERE rank_desc = 1
),
low_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM ranked_artists WHERE rank_asc = 1
),
artist_albums AS (
    SELECT ArtistId, AlbumId FROM albums WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist UNION SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist)
),
customer_artist_spending AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (inv.CustomerId, alb.ArtistId)
        inv.CustomerId,
        alb.ArtistId,
        SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) as customer_spending
    FROM artist_albums aa
    JOIN albums alb ON aa.AlbumId = alb.AlbumId
    JOIN tracks t ON alb.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId, alb.ArtistId
),
avg_spending AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(CASE WHEN ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist) THEN customer_spending END) as avg_top_spending,
        AVG(CASE WHEN ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist) THEN customer_spending END) as avg_low_spending
    FROM customer_artist_spending
)
SELECT ABS(avg_top_spending - avg_low_spending) as absolute_difference
FROM avg_spending

WITH artist_sales AS (
    SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) as total_sales
    FROM albums alb
    JOIN artists a ON alb.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
    JOIN tracks t ON alb.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
),
ranked_artists AS (
    SELECT ArtistId, Name, total_sales,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales DESC, Name ASC) as rank_desc,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY total_sales ASC, Name ASC) as rank_asc
    FROM artist_sales
),
top_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM ranked_artists WHERE rank_desc = 1
),
low_artist AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM ranked_artists WHERE rank_asc = 1
),
target_artists AS (
    SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist UNION SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist
),
albums_for_target AS (
    SELECT AlbumId FROM albums WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM target_artists)
),
customer_spending AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT inv.CustomerId,
           SUM(CASE WHEN alb.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist) THEN ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity ELSE 0 END) as top_artist_spending,
           SUM(CASE WHEN alb.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist) THEN ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity ELSE 0 END) as low_artist_spending,
           SUM(CASE WHEN alb.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist) THEN ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity ELSE 0 END) +
           SUM(CASE WHEN alb.ArtistId = (SELECT ArtistId FROM low_artist) THEN ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity ELSE 0 END) as total_spending
    FROM albums_for_target alb
    JOIN tracks t ON alb.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
    JOIN invoice_items ii ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
    JOIN invoices inv ON ii.InvoiceId = inv.InvoiceId
    WHERE alb.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM target_artists)
    GROUP BY inv.CustomerId
)
SELECT 
    (SELECT AVG(top_artist_spending) FROM customer_spending WHERE top_artist_spending IS NOT NULL) as avg_top_customer_spending,
    (SELECT AVG(low_artist_spending) FROM customer_spending WHERE low_artist_spending IS NOT NULL) as avg_low_customer_spending,
    ABS((SELECT AVG(top_artist_spending) FROM customer_spending WHERE top_artist_spending IS NOT NULL) - 
        (SELECT AVG(low_artist_spending) FROM customer_spending WHERE low_artist_spending IS NOT NULL)) as difference
